META.pe_narrative: META's forward P/E rose into 2024-early 2025 on 'Year of Efficiency' discipline and AI-driven ad-targeting gains (Advantage+), then compressed to ~17-18x by mid-2026 as FY26 capex guidance was raised three times ($115-135B→$125-145B→$130-145B) and FCF cratered to $784M in Q2. JPMorgan's downgrade crystallized the market's fear: 'a harder path to ROI beyond advertising than the Street has modeled.'
